T-002.Title: Invalidate and regenerate the measured test-metrics.json

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first: the artifact guard below rejects the committed test-metrics.json because it still names the four deleted identities. Then create a unique empty run directory with mkdtemp under os.tmpdir(), record its absolute path at .ngrace/scratch/inode-evidence-phase1-t002/junit-dir.txt, invalidate the committed test-metrics.json so the runner's file-set-and-count-sum freshness predicate cannot leave it untouched, and run the artifact-producing action exactly once: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),os=require("os"),cp=require("child_process");const d=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),"ngrace-inode-t002-"));if(fs.readdirSync(d).length)throw new Error("run dir not empty");fs.mkdirSync(".ngrace/scratch/inode-evidence-phase1-t002",{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(".ngrace/scratch/inode-evidence-phase1-t002/junit-dir.txt",d+"\n");fs.rmSync("test-metrics.json",{force:true});const r=cp.spawnSync("bun",["run","test:metrics"],{stdio:"inherit",env:{...process.env,TMPDIR:d}});process.exit(r.status??1);' After it the artifact guard passes and the provenance check passes: the produced artifact's case multiset equals the single reporter JUnit in the recorded run directory, with no (provisional) entry and no removed title. The provenance check fails closed when the recording is missing, the recorded directory is missing, or it holds zero or multiple ngrace-junit-*.xml files; it writes a sanitized dated transcript to .ngrace/scratch/inode-evidence-phase1-t002/provenance.json without removing the OS run directory; remove that directory and its pointer after close evidence. scripts/test-metrics.ts is not edited.

Verification.Command: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("test-metrics.json","utf8"));const removed=["same-path replacement is detected by inode and preserved","the opened handle is the first identity source","the observed lock identity is captured","byte-identical prerequisites"].filter(t=>a.tests.some(x=>x.name.includes(t)));const provisional=a.tests.filter(x=>x.name==="(provisional)");const sum=a.files.reduce((s,f)=>s+f.tests,0);if(removed.length||provisional.length||sum!==a.tests.length)throw new Error("stale artifact: removed="+JSON.stringify(removed)+" provisional="+provisional.length+" sum="+sum+"/"+a.tests.length);console.log("artifact current:",a.tests.length,"cases");'

bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),crypto=require("crypto");const rec=".ngrace/scratch/inode-evidence-phase1-t002/junit-dir.txt";if(!fs.existsSync(rec))throw new Error("missing recorded run directory");const dir=fs.readFileSync(rec,"utf8").trim();if(!dir||!fs.existsSync(dir))throw new Error("recorded run directory missing");const junits=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>/^ngrace-junit-.*\.xml$/.test(f));if(junits.length!==1)throw new Error("expected exactly one reporter junit, got "+junits.length);const {parseJUnit}=require("./scripts/test-metrics.ts");const run=parseJUnit(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,junits[0]),"utf8"),"x");const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("test-metrics.json","utf8"));const key=t=>t.file+"::"+t.name;const ms=arr=>{const m=new Map();for(const x of arr)m.set(key(x),(m.get(key(x))||0)+1);return m;};const mj=ms(run.tests),ma=ms(a.tests);let diff=0;for(const [k,v] of mj)if((ma.get(k)||0)!==v)diff++;for(const [k,v] of ma)if((mj.get(k)||0)!==v)diff++;if(diff)throw new Error("case multiset differs on "+diff);if(a.tests.some(t=>t.name==="(provisional)"))throw new Error("provisional entry remains");const removed=["same-path replacement is detected by inode and preserved","the opened handle is the first identity source","the observed lock identity is captured","byte-identical prerequisites"].filter(t=>a.tests.some(x=>x.name.includes(t)));if(removed.length)throw new Error("removed titles remain: "+JSON.stringify(removed));const digest=arr=>crypto.createHash("sha256").update(arr.map(key).sort().join("\n")).digest("hex");const t={generated:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),cases:a.tests.length,artifactMultiSetDigest:digest(a.tests),junitMultiSetDigest:digest(run.tests)};fs.mkdirSync(".ngrace/scratch/inode-evidence-phase1-t002",{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(".ngrace/scratch/inode-evidence-phase1-t002/provenance.json",JSON.stringify(t,null,2)+"\n");console.log("provenance ok: cases="+t.cases+" digest="+t.artifactMultiSetDigest);'
